newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Hoogovens to redeem convertible bond.
newsitem.headline: Hoogovens to redeem convertible bond.

text.p: Steel and aluminium group Hoogovens NV said on Wednesday it planned to exercise its right of early redemption on its 300 million guilder 4.5 percent convertible subordinated bond due 2001.
Hoogovens said the move was aimed at encouraging holders of the bonds to make use of their right to convert them into shares and thus strengthen the company's equity base.
The conversion price of 74.80 guilders per share represents a substantial discount to the current price on the Amsterdam bourse where the shares closed at 104.60 guilders on Wednesday.
Hoogovens will redeem any unconverted bonds at par value on August 11.
Hoogovens had 32.45 million shares outstanding at the end of 1996 and full conversion of the subordinated loan would result in the creation of four million shares.
A Hoogovens spokesman said he did not know to what extent holders of the bonds had already exercised their conversion option.
